history_summary: Record term-only Rhodanobacter reference correspondence while retaining the black-soil membership and mechanism holds.
history_details: The pinned native crosswalk adds one Rhodanobacter genus correspondence with 15 of 15 filtered reference genomes, one changed grounding status and two native inline events. Native status stdout processes all three descriptors; the event correctly reports one changed entry. Existing Burkholderia and Achromobacter blocks and status values remain semantically unchanged. This is correspondence for the already encoded genus term, not verification that a Rhodanobacter stock belongs to the paper's four-isolate SynCom. The abstract identifies NMC keystone groups and separately describes that SynCom without exposing the complete stock roster. The 97.27, 68.00 and 22.91 percent source results belong to the glucose-amended NMC experiment and are not reassigned to the SynCom. Issues 2404, 2405 and 2406 remain unresolved, including performance attribution, membership/complex collapse and unsupported mechanisms or arrows. All current biological claims, absent stock fields, original source snippets, three nodes, two arrows and prior history are preserved as existing content, not endorsed as correct. No strain identity, species, abundance, degrader function or experimental mechanism is certified by the generic 15/15 reference population. The prior full-record partial assessment remains needs_curation with scientific_review:false. This correction does not complete scientific review, generated products or aggregate QC.
